description: This file is a PHP source code for a web page that provides troubleshooting options for resetting or restoring a gateway device. It includes PHP logic, HTML markup, and JavaScript/jQuery code for handling user interactions such as resetting the device, Wi-Fi, password, and other settings.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Initiates a reset or restore process based on user action, sending AJAX requests to perform device resets, Wi-Fi restarts, or password resets, and managing UI feedback during the process.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has finished rebooting by attempting to reload the index page; if unsuccessful, retries after 2 minutes.
